tasks.prompt: Open the app and decide what deserves attention first today without being told where to look.
success_criteria: Finds Today/Action Center
Can state the top action and why it matters

tasks.prompt: For one owned Pokémon, decide whether to keep, build, evolve, trade, rescan, or leave it alone.
success_criteria: Finds the exact owned record
Explains the recommendation in plain language
Notices irreversible or high-cost warnings
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant takes or recommends an irreversible action while missing a visible blocker or uncertainty warning.

tasks.prompt: Look up a species you do not own and explain what the page can tell you versus what is current-game information.
success_criteria: Finds species/form reference
Distinguishes stable reference from current availability

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between IV percentage and PvP rank using only help available in the interface.
success_criteria: Finds a contextual definition without hover
Correctly states that PvP rank is not the same as IV percentage or universal battle strength

tasks.prompt: Find what changed since the previous collection export and identify one change worth reviewing.
success_criteria: Finds the timeline
Can distinguish added/removed/changed records from current-game events

tasks.prompt: Free 50 Pokémon storage slots as safely as possible, stopping if the app cannot support 50 high-confidence candidates.
success_criteria: Uses review tiers rather than blind transfer
Recognizes protected and unknown states
Produces only review/search batches the app says are representable
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant treats an unknown/protected Pokémon as safe to transfer because the interface hid or minimized the uncertainty.

tasks.prompt: Turn a recommendation into a small Pokémon GO or Poke Genie handoff you could actually use on your phone.
success_criteria: Finds the handoff action
Can tell exact from approximate/not-representable conditions
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant believes an approximate search string preserves protections that the interface says cannot be represented exactly.

tasks.prompt: Review a new Poke Genie CSV before upload and identify whether it is safe to accept.
success_criteria: Finds schema/timestamp/duplicate warnings
Does not confuse local preflight with canonical import
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant proceeds despite a blocking schema/timestamp error because the blocking state is not understandable.

tasks.prompt: Build a Pokémon GO search that protects a requested category and explain any protection the game cannot express.
success_criteria: Uses AND/OR/NOT correctly
Can identify exact versus approximate output
Does not assume unsupported protections are included
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant interprets a lossy or approximate bulk-transfer search as exact.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact Poke Genie-style naming template that keeps the information needed for rapid sorting in Pokémon GO.
success_criteria: Understands every symbol
Result fits the intended in-game workflow
Avoids redundant fields unless intentionally useful

tasks.prompt: Identify one missing family/form target and explain why it appears as a gap.
success_criteria: Finds the gap reason
Can distinguish missing, unknown, and unreleased/unsupported states

tasks.prompt: Find the weakest coverage area in the owned roster and identify one realistic improvement path.
success_criteria: Understands the coverage metric
Does not mistake a missing current-data input for poor roster value

tasks.prompt: Compare available evolutions for an owned Pokémon and decide whether evolving now is reversible or event-sensitive.
success_criteria: Finds exact owned prerequisites
Notices event/exclusive-move timing when present
Does not infer missing state
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant evolves through an irreversible/event-sensitive path without seeing the relevant warning.

tasks.prompt: Decide whether to use a normal TM, Elite TM, remove Frustration later, or wait.
success_criteria: Distinguishes current/legacy/exclusive move availability
Sees Elite TM opportunity cost
Understands when waiting reduces risk
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant spends an Elite TM or other scarce move resource without understanding a clearly known cheaper/waiting alternative.

tasks.prompt: Compare two planned builds that compete for the same scarce resource and choose what to fund first.
success_criteria: Finds reserve/commitment conflicts
Unknown balances are not treated as zero
Can explain opportunity cost
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant double-spends a tracked resource or treats an unknown balance as available.

tasks.prompt: Build a raid team from exact owned Pokémon and explain the group-size assumptions behind it.
success_criteria: Uses exact owned records
Can state weather/friendship/party/group assumptions
Distinguishes simulation result from official fact

tasks.prompt: Choose a Max Battle party and identify any Max Move or resource blockers before investing.
success_criteria: Finds exact owned candidates
Understands required Max mechanics/resources
Sees cost before investment
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant commits a scarce Max investment without seeing a known blocker or cheaper owned alternative.

tasks.prompt: Choose a Mega/Primal candidate for a goal and identify whether the app knows its current eligibility and resource state.
success_criteria: Separates stable eligibility from current availability
Does not infer untracked Mega Energy or progress
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant treats unknown local resource/progress state as sufficient to perform the transformation.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate whether Hyper Training/Bottle Cap investment is justified for an exact owned Pokémon.
success_criteria: Sees prerequisites and expiration when applicable
Compares alternatives before committing
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant commits a scarce or expiring item without understanding prerequisites, expiry, or a clearly better alternative.

tasks.prompt: Choose the next buddy based on an explicit goal and understand the estimated work remaining.
success_criteria: Selects by goal rather than arbitrary score
Can distinguish known progress from estimated work

tasks.prompt: Build a Team GO Rocket party for a current lineup and identify what happens if the lineup data is stale.
success_criteria: Uses exact owned party members
Recognizes branching lineup uncertainty
Stale lineup data blocks current advice

tasks.prompt: Find one currently obtainable target that improves a collection goal and verify when the opportunity ends.
success_criteria: Finds source/freshness and exact availability window
Does not treat stale or unknown encounter data as current

tasks.prompt: Prepare for an upcoming event and identify any evolution/move deadline that differs from the main event window.
success_criteria: Reads exact local times
Recognizes overlapping or extended windows
Stale event data is not actionable

tasks.prompt: Review an exact Pokémon for a trade and explain what is known, blocked, or uncertain before committing.
success_criteria: Finds trade blockers
Understands IV/CP reroll uncertainty
Separates in-person and remote rules when applicable
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant treats a blocked or uncertain trade as guaranteed eligible or assumes post-trade stats.

tasks.prompt: Review a Fusion, Adventure Effect, or other special-mechanic action and identify resource and reversibility consequences.
success_criteria: Finds required owned prerequisites
Understands reversible versus irreversible/resource-consuming consequences
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant performs or recommends an irreversible/resource-consuming special mechanic without seeing the consequence.

tasks.prompt: Compare two owned PvP candidates and explain rank/stat-product versus matchup/CMP tradeoffs under pinned assumptions.
success_criteria: Finds model/version and assumptions
Does not call rank 1 universally best
Can inspect text/table results without relying on a chart
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant makes an expensive build solely from rank without seeing matchup/model tradeoffs presented by the tool.

tasks.prompt: Use global search to move between an owned record, species reference, mechanic, and saved view without losing domain context.
success_criteria: Can tell which domain each result belongs to
Current-data results disappear or downgrade when stale

tasks.prompt: Inspect a consequential recommendation and trace its owned facts, source authority, freshness, calculation/model, assumptions, and unknowns.
success_criteria: Can distinguish official fact, community data, simulation, inference, local fact, and unknown
Can find remediation for stale/missing prerequisites
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant cannot tell a simulation/inference from an official current fact for a consequential action.

tasks.prompt: Export one bounded decision packet for expert review without sharing the full collection or unrelated private state.
success_criteria: Previews exactly what will be shared
Packet includes build/source/assumption context
Unrelated private data is excluded by default

tasks.prompt: Diagnose a seeded unhealthy state and choose the least-destructive recovery action.
success_criteria: Identifies the failing subsystem
Does not default to clearing all site data
Diagnostic copy omits full collection/private notes
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant chooses destructive local-state clearing when a safer documented repair exists because the UI fails to communicate it.

tasks.prompt: Back up local planning state, validate the backup, and restore it without replacing valid state with corrupt input.
success_criteria: Can identify backup version/scope
Corrupt/incompatible restore fails closed
Canonical collection data is not silently mutated
tasks.critical_error_definition: Participant loses valid local state because corrupt/incompatible restore input was accepted without a blocking warning.

tasks.prompt: Prepare a coherent offline pack, then verify how current-game data ages and expires while offline.
success_criteria: Can inspect pack version/size/scope
Expired current data becomes visibly expired offline
Removing a pack does not clear unrelated local state

tasks.prompt: Using keyboard or screen-reader navigation only, find the first actionable item and its safety/freshness status.
success_criteria: Logical focus/reading order
Status is conveyed in text, not color alone
Action is reachable without pointer input

tasks.prompt: At 400% zoom or with a screen reader, review a cleanup candidate and determine why it is protected or risky.
success_criteria: No two-dimensional scrolling is required for the primary decision
Protection and uncertainty text remains available
Approve/exclude controls remain reachable
tasks.critical_error_definition: Assistive-technology user cannot perceive a protection or uncertainty that prevents an unsafe transfer recommendation.

tasks.prompt: With reduced motion/high contrast or screen reader, identify the next deadline and distinguish overlapping windows.
success_criteria: Ordering does not depend on color
Dates/times have meaningful text
Reduced-motion mode does not remove information

tasks.prompt: Using keyboard only, open global search, move through grouped results, activate one, and return without a focus trap.
success_criteria: Visible focus remains in viewport
Group/domain labels are announced
Escape/close returns focus predictably
